name: Yen Tu-Vinh Nghiem-Con Son, Kiep Bac Complex of Monuments and Landscapes
description: In northern Viet Nam, this cluster of 12 sites is centred on the forested Yen Tu mountains, where the Tran emperors ruled in the 13th and 14th centuries. Emperor Tran Nhan Tong retired here and founded Truc Lam Zen, a distinctly Vietnamese form of Buddhism. Pilgrims still climb to pagodas and shrines, reaching the 70-ton Bronze Pagoda near the 1,068-metre summit.
